memory_update.text: MIDD is the clean public reference anchor for restaurant kitchen equipment, refrigeration, beverage dispensing and labor-saving commercial foodservice equipment.
PAR is an underfollowed small-cap candidate for restaurant operating automation: POS, ordering, payments, loyalty, back-office, inventory and labor workflows.
FARM is a below-$300M speculative exception with hidden beverage supply, coffee-equipment service and route-density exposure to restaurants and foodservice operators.
RR is a direct but high-risk restaurant/hospitality robotics candidate; require SEC-filed customer, deployment, revenue and cash-runway verification before promoting beyond speculative_shadow.

Need another pass for private or non-US-listed but strategically important restaurant equipment chokepoints such as Ali Group/Welbilt, Rational, Henny Penny, Franke, Hussmann, Parts Town and Miso Robotics; these may shape public-company read-throughs even if not investable as US-listed equities.

node: Labor productivity, kitchen equipment, beverage dispensing, refrigeration, and automation
summary: Expanded the universe for restaurant labor-productivity and uptime chokepoints around chain-approved equipment, beverage systems, restaurant operating software, coffee/beverage service infrastructure, and early-stage robotics. The highest-quality reference exposure is Middleby because it directly manufactures commercial foodservice cooking, refrigeration, beverage, IoT and robotics-related equipment. The underfollowed lane is more interesting in PAR Technology and Farmer Brothers: PAR maps to enterprise restaurant POS/back-office/labor/ordering workflows, while Farmer Brothers is a micro-cap speculative exception with coffee, beverage, equipment service and route density exposure. Richtech Robotics is included only as a speculative_shadow candidate because it is directly tied to restaurant/hospitality robots but has weak proof quality, small-company execution risk, and controversy risk. No trading recommendation is implied.
